info.name: WisePlayer API – Complete Collection
info.description:
Full Postman collection for WisePlayer backend. Covers Device, Playlist, Live TV, Movies, Series, Stream, Subscription, Payment, Reseller, Credit, and all Admin endpoints.

Variables:
- {{baseUrl}} – e.g. http://localhost:8080
- {{deviceToken}} – JWT from device validate/register
- {{resellerToken}} – JWT from reseller login
- {{adminToken}} – JWT from admin login
- {{playlistId}} – UUID of a saved playlist
- {{deviceId}} – UUID or MAC of a device

item.name: 📂 Series
item.description:
Full 3-level browse flow:
1. Get Series Categories
2. Get Series list by category
3. Get Series Info (seasons + episodes) by seriesId
4. Resolve episode playback URL
